import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Scatter plot: Price vs Megapixels with ISO as size
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                      s=df['max_iso']/1000, alpha=0.7, 
                      c=df['model_year'], cmap='viridis')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels (Size = Max ISO/1000, Color = Year)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Model Year')

# 2. Bar plot: Average price by brand
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
brand_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values()
brand_price.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(brand_price)))
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Box plot: Price distribution by body type
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='price_usd', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax3.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax3.set_title('Price Distribution by Body Type')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Line plot: Camera features over years
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
ax4.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['megapixels'], 'o-', label='Megapixels', linewidth=2)
ax4.plot(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['max_iso']/1000, 's-', label='Max ISO (x1000)', linewidth=2)
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax4.set_ylabel('Value')
ax4.set_title('Camera Features Over Years')
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Histogram: Price distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
ax5.hist(df['price_usd'], bins=10, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Price (USD)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax5.set_title('Price Distribution')

# 6. Pie chart: Sensor type distribution
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(sensor_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')

# 7. Heatmap: Correlation matrix
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
numeric_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            square=True, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax7)
ax7.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap')

# 8. Bar plot: Weight by brand with body type hue
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
sns.barplot(data=df, x='brand', y='weight_grams', hue='body_type', ax=ax8)
ax8.set_xlabel('Brand')
ax8.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)')
ax8.set_title('Camera Weight by Brand and Body Type')
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax8.legend(title='Body Type')

# 9. Scatter plot matrix (simplified)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
scatter_matrix_vars = ['megapixels', 'max_iso', 'price_usd']
for i, var in enumerate(scatter_matrix_vars):
    for j, var2 in enumerate(scatter_matrix_vars):
        if i != j:
            ax9.scatter(df[var], df[var2], alpha=0.6)
ax9.set_xlabel('Features')
ax9.set_ylabel('Features')
ax9.set_title('Feature Relationships')
ax9.text(0.5, 0.5, 'Scatter Matrix:\nMegapixels vs Max ISO vs Price', 
         transform=ax9.transAxes, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
